name: tieng-han-cung-queenie
description: Trang cá nhân của Nguyễn Hồng Nguyệt Quế (Queenie) — Thạc sĩ Biên–Phiên dịch Hàn–Việt.

scripts.serve: node build.mjs && node --eval "import('node:http').then(async({default:http})=>{const fs=await import('node:fs/promises');const path=await import('node:path');const types={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.jpeg':'image/jpeg','.jpg':'image/jpeg','.png':'image/png','.xml':'application/xml','.txt':'text/plain; charset=utf-8'};http.createServer(async(req,res)=>{let p=decodeURIComponent(req.url.split('?')[0]);if(p.endsWith('/'))p+='index.html';const f=path.join(process.cwd(),'dist',p);try{const b=await fs.readFile(f);res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':types[path.extname(f)]||'application/octet-stream'});res.end(b);}catch{try{const b=await fs.readFile(path.join(process.cwd(),'dist','404.html'));res.writeHead(404,{'Content-Type':'text/html; charset=utf-8'});res.end(b);}catch{res.writeHead(404);res.end('404');}}}).listen(process.env.PORT||8000,()=>console.log('http://localhost:'+(process.env.PORT||8000)));})"
